def dump_ball():
    res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':58,'col':46}])
    af = last_animation_frames or []
    for i,f in enumerate(af):
        fa = f.ascii.split('\n')

        if not cells: print(f'f{i} none'); continue
        rs=[x[0] for x in cells]; cs=[x[1] for x in cells]
        shape = [''.join('Y' if (r,c) in set(cells) else '.' for c in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1)) for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1)]
        print(f'f{i} r{min(rs)}-{max(rs)} c{min(cs)}-{max(cs)}')
        for s in shape: print('    ',s)
    print('done', res.get('level_completed'))
    return res
